map.语言学习时把慢速播客或公开课加速到 1.25x~1.5x 节省时间，同时保留原语: In language learning, speed up a slow podcast or open course to 1.25x~1.5x to save time while keeping the original intonation for shadowing and imitation.
map.把长讲座或会议录音整体提速复听，快速定位需要精听的关键段落。: Speed up a long lecture or meeting recording to review it faster and quickly locate the key passages that need close listening.
map.为短视频配音生成 0.75x 慢速版或 1.2x 快速预览版，校对口播节奏与停顿: Generate a 0.75x slow version or a 1.2x quick preview for short-video voice-over to match speaking rhythm and pauses.
map.一段采样率 44100Hz、时长 120 秒的语音，加速到 1.5x 后播放时长: For 44100Hz speech of 120 seconds, speeding up to 1.5x gives a playback duration of about 120÷1.5=80 seconds, the playback rate becomes 1.5x and the pitch stays the same; with plain resampling (no pitch preservation) the pitch would be raised by about 7 semitones and sound cartoonish, so front-end time stretching needs WSOLA or a phase vocoder to rearrange the time domain and correct phase.
map.变速不变调是怎么做到的？: How is speed changed without shifting pitch?
map.核心是在不改变基频的前提下重排音频的时间结构：先用重叠相加（OLA）分帧，再用: The core is rearranging the audio time structure without changing the fundamental frequency: first frame the signal with overlap-add (OLA), then use WSOLA to search neighboring frames for the most similar waveform alignment position, or use a phase vocoder to unwrap phase in the frequency domain. Playback rate changes while pitch is preserved.
map.加速或减速会不会损坏音质？: Does speeding up or slowing down damage audio quality?
map.适度范围（约 0.5x~2x）内算法失真很小；过度变速会出现金属感或抖动，且加速: Within a moderate range (about 0.5x~2x) algorithm distortion is minimal; extreme rates introduce metallic artifacts or jitter, and speeding up compresses silence while slowing down stretches reverb tails. Preview boundary speeds before exporting to confirm naturalness.
